name: Mir
about: Mir (1986-017A), a station core, launched 1986 Feb 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1986 Mar 21), held fixed
